simple.meaning: חֲשׂוּפָא (Chăsûwphâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chasupha , one of the Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲשׂוּפָא (H2817) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:43, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲשׂוּפָא (H2817) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲשׂוּפָא (H2817) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲשׂוּפָא (Chăsûwphâʼ) / H2817 is traced through Ezra 2:43, Nehemiah 7:46 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2817. Chasupha חֲשֻׁפָא חֲשׂוּפָא, proper name, masculine head of a family of Nethinim among the returning exiles חֲשׂוּפָא Ezra 2:43 = חֲשֻׂפָא Neh 7:46 .
